subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and should it surface through `session_status`, a dedicated usage tool, runtime metadata, or all of those surfaces?
rationale: The missing source data is clear, but choosing source/units semantics, exact-versus-estimated precedence, persistence, and public agent API shape is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Add provider-cost metadata
options.body: Create an additive exact-cost contract with source, units, OpenRouter `usage.cost`, `cost_details`, and fallback-to-estimate semantics across runtime, transcripts, and session/status surfaces.

options.title: Fold into broader usage API
options.body: Make this wait for the structured `session_status` or native usage-ledger work so exact OpenRouter costs become one provider-specific field in a broader usage contract.

options.title: Keep estimates only
options.body: Document current local estimated-cost behavior and leave exact provider-billing capture to external plugins or future ClawHub accounting integrations.

recommendation.title: Add provider-cost metadata
recommendation.body: Create an additive exact-cost contract with source, units, OpenRouter `usage.cost`, `cost_details`, and fallback-to-estimate semantics across runtime, transcripts, and session/status surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation, usage-cost reporting, runtime metadata, and prior review context for this issue.
